text:
nora: Quick sync 00: we need a compact migration note for v1->v2 focusing on SDK param rename (embed_model -> model_id) and a tiny example showing safe model swaps for embeddings. Target: 1-pager + 2 short snippets.
sam: I can author the TS snippet and add a tiny test. prefer to show `EXPECTED_DIM` guard and a fallback to a pinned stable model.
priya: I9ll take the TL;DR and the banner copy. legal wants softer language; suggested: 'we recommend reindexing'.
alex: confirm: runtime doesn't auto-convert embedding dims. we'll add a clear line that reindexing is required if dims differ.
riley: I'll review for clarity and add a link to the reindex guide.
docs-bot: Reminder: add the page to the 'deprecations' sidebar and label the PR docs-migration.
nora: rough page outline: TL;DR banner, What changed, Quick migration steps, TS snippet, Python snippet, Smoke test notes, PR checklist. keep it under 300 words.
sam: TS sketch:
```ts
// Guarded embed call: prefer pinned model when dims mismatch
const meta = await client.models.get('my-embed-v2')
const dim = meta.embedding_dim
if (dim !== EXPECTED_DIM) {
  await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'my-embed-v1', input: ['hello'] })
} else {
  await client.embeddings.create({ model: meta.id, input: ['hello'] })
}
```
priya: Draft banner: "Deprecation: /v1/models will be removed on 2026-04-15. If swapping embedding models, vector dimensions may change; we recommend reindexing or pinning previous model IDs in production."
alex: good. add one-liner about param rename: `embed_model` -> `model_id` and example mapping.
riley: small UX note: add a 'backwards compatibility' caution for cached batched outputs.
sam: will compress snippet and link to samples repo for fuller patterns. adding smoke test harness in PR.
priya: will post draft in ~1h. timeline: PR opened by sam tomorrow WIP, reviews by riley/alex within 48h, merge by 2026-03-25 for localization.
docs-bot: If you include strings for i18n, mark them with i18n keys in the PR description.
nora: thanks everyone. sam, please ping when PR is up.
